name: rss
label: Reading list
description: RSS and Atom feeds, fetched on this machine (so a browser CORS rule is not the problem) and cached in jobs\rss-cache.json for fifteen minutes. The Reading card in Morning Brief renders the latest items; feeds are added and removed from that card. No page of its own.

steps: In Apps > Morning Brief, the Reading card has a feeds button: paste an RSS or Atom URL and a name. Feeds live in jobs\feeds.json; the cache is jobs\rss-cache.json and expires after fifteen minutes.
The card lists the newest items across all feeds (title, feed, age). The agent can ask for the same list with rss_latest in a chat, which is how a morning brief routine would quote it.
fixes: The fetch failed: the URL may need https, may be a page rather than a feed, or the site refused the request. The card keeps the last good items and shows the error against that feed; removing and re-adding re-tries immediately.
An empty feed is a real answer. New items appear after the fifteen-minute cache expires, or press refresh in the card to force a fetch.
